summary: Iteration 19 — verified the Telnyx-balance row, the new /api/inworld/preview endpoint, provider-aware /api/voices/preview, and the changed Settings/Campaigns UI. Backend: 40/40 tests pass (12 new API tests in test_iteration19_telnyx_balance_inworld.py, 1 new telnyx-balance-row test, 27/27 existing test_telnyx_inworld.py incl. streaming_start params + WAV header). Live probe of the demo org (tts_stt_provider=elevenlabs, NO telnyx/inworld keys): GET /api/settings/integrations/balances -> 200 {balances:[elevenlabs(ok=false 'Invalid API key.'), 3cx], checked_at} and correctly OMITS the telnyx row; after saving a sentinel telnyx key the telnyx row appears with unit='balance', ok=false, detail='Invalid Telnyx API key.' (no 500) and the original key was restored. POST /api/inworld/preview {voice_id:'Ashley'} -> 200 {audio_url:null, error:'No Inworld API key configured.'} (also for a bogus voice id and for a missing voice_id — never 500, 401 without auth). POST /api/voices/preview {voice_id:'george'} -> 200 with mock=true, provider='elevenlabs_error' (saved EL key is a stale/invalid test key). GET /api/voices -> 200, provider='elevenlabs', 12 voices. Frontend (admin@coldwave.ai login OK): Settings shows data-testid='balances-grid' + 'refresh-balances-button' which refreshes without error; 'preview-inworld-voice' renders and is correctly DISABLED with no voice selected; Campaigns → Voices tab renders 12 voice cards each with preview-voice-<id>, the click works with no crash, 'voices-inworld-note' is absent and the ElevenLabs mock-mode banner is absent (elevenlabs_enabled=true) — matching the provider-aware logic. No page/console errors other than the expected pre-login 401 on /api/auth/me. NOTE: no real Telnyx/Twilio call was placed (impossible in preview), so the live-audio silence fix is only verified at unit level.

minor.issue: STT for the Telnyx path is Inworld-only (select_stt_provider). If an org runs Telnyx + ElevenLabs TTS without an Inworld key, the greeting plays but the agent can NEVER respond to the prospect (media events are dropped, only a logger.warning). Requirement 'Telnyx must work with both Inworld TTS and ElevenLabs TTS' is therefore only half met: TTS yes, hearing the prospect no. Surface this in the UI (Settings/Campaign warning) or add a non-Inworld STT.

The greeting is now gated on the Telnyx 'start' event with no timeout/fallback — if 'start' never arrives (stream error, mis-configured connection) the call stays silent forever. Add an asyncio timeout (~3-5s) that logs and greets anyway.

Pacing uses `await asyncio.sleep(0.02)` per 160-byte frame; per-iteration overhead makes playback slower than realtime and drifts on long replies. Use a monotonic deadline (next_send += 0.02) instead.
STILL returns provider secrets (inworld_api_key, telnyx_public_key, elevenlabs_api_key booleans are returned as real values) to the browser — carried over unfixed from iterations 17/18.

Leftover test pollution from earlier iterations: voice 'george' has display_name 'TEST_George' and persona 'TEST_persona_calm' (visible on the Voices tab card), and twilio_account_sid='ACtest_sentinel_sid'. The saved ElevenLabs key is invalid so the balances card reads 'Invalid API key.' Clean up before demo.

issues: 'Preview voice' is correctly disabled with no voice selected, but there is no tooltip/hint explaining why — the TTS VOICE select shows 'Test key to load voices', so the disabled state is discoverable but not explained.
First card title reads 'TEST_George' (stale seeded customization, see backend minor issue) — cosmetic data problem, not a code bug.

action_items: Add a start-event timeout fallback in telnyx_relay so a missing 'start' cannot re-create the silent-call symptom.
Warn (UI + logs) when Telnyx is the telephony provider and Inworld STT is not configured — otherwise the AI can't hear the prospect even though TTS works.
Mask secrets in GET /api/settings/integrations (open since iteration 17).
Clean the demo org: remove TEST_George/TEST_persona_calm voice customization, the sentinel Twilio SID, and the invalid ElevenLabs key (balances card currently shows 'Invalid API key.').
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py balances: the telnyx block mirrors elevenlabs/twilio correctly and is skipped when no key exists — verified both branches live. All three blocks are near-identical ~20-line httpx try/except copies; extract a small helper to satisfy DRY.

/api/inworld/preview returns 200 with {audio_url:null, error} for every failure path (no key, bogus voice, no voice_id) — good graceful degradation; consider also returning the resolved voice_id for UI feedback.

/api/voices/preview inworld branch wraps LINEAR16 in _pcm16_to_wav_b64 (WAV header unit-tested) and keeps the backward-compatible 'mock' flag on the elevenlabs branch — no shape break for Campaigns.jsx.
routes.py is 1677 lines — split into routers (voices, settings/integrations, campaigns) per the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on scope (login, balances grid + refresh, disabled Inworld preview button, Voices tab 12 cards + preview click, no inworld note / no mock banner as expected)

seed_data_creation: No new records. Temporarily saved telnyx_api_key='KEY_TEST_invalid_telnyx_sentinel' to prove the balance row appears, then restored the original empty value (asserted in fixture teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration19_telnyx_balance_inworld.py tests/test_iteration19_telnyx_balance_row.py tests/test_telnyx_inworld.py -v -p no:randomly. Demo org state after this run: tts_stt_provider=elevenlabs, NO telnyx/inworld keys, elevenlabs key present but INVALID (so previews return provider='elevenlabs_error', mock=true and the balances card says 'Invalid API key.'). Balances endpoint returns an OBJECT {balances:[...], checked_at}, not a bare list. Frontend login button is get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'); Voices tab is reached by clicking the 'Voices' text tab on /campaigns; preview buttons are [data-testid^='preview-voice-']. Real Telnyx/Twilio calls and the media WebSocket remain untestable in preview.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no new defect reproduced. The remaining silence risk is architectural: (a) greeting now waits for Telnyx 'start' with no timeout, and (b) Telnyx STT is Inworld-only, so a Telnyx+ElevenLabs org hears the greeting but the agent never replies because inbound media is discarded when no Inworld STT session exists.
